QUESTIONS JEWELLERS ASK

Jewellery software questions, answered straight.

What is Jwero?

Jwero is the autonomous jewellery operating system that runs the whole business on one record: customers, counter billing at the live gold rate, stock, purchase, the workshop, schemes, books, team, marketing, sales, conversions, promotions and much more, with AI that does the routine work on its own, and asks for approval only where you want it. Run it yourself after a free trial, or let Jwero’s specialists run it for you, so you can focus on what matters most.

Do I need to integrate anything?

Not between your own tools, because there is only one. Customers, WhatsApp, catalogue, website, counter, stock, workshop, schemes, accounts, marketing and HR are all built into Jwero and share one record. Jwero connects outward only to what has to stay outside: Tally or Zoho Books for your accountant, Meta, your payment gateway, your phone line, and Shopify or WooCommerce if you keep that store. We set those up with you. See what Jwero connects to.

Do I have to replace my billing or accounting software?

No. Keep your books exactly where your accountant likes them, Jwero bridges to Tally and Zoho Books. See the Migration Centre.

Does the AI work on its own, or wait for my approval?

It works on its own. Replies, follow-ups and reminders go out automatically, inside daily caps and quiet hours you set, and every action is logged. You choose which kinds of action need your approval first, and a kill switch stops it at once. See how governance works.

How long does it take to go live?

Set-up takes a day for most shops: customers imported, your WhatsApp number connected, catalogue published, AI working inside your limits from day one.

How do I start?

Tap Try Free Now and create your account with Google, LinkedIn or email. You get a free trial with every module, and your price is shown in your account when the trial ends. We can import your customers, catalogue and stock with you, and connect your WhatsApp number. If you would rather hand the work over, Jwero can run it for you. See how that works.

What if the internet drops at the counter?

Jwero runs in the browser, so the counter needs an internet connection; offline counter billing can be switched on for your business so sales are kept on the device and sync later. A phone hotspot is enough to keep billing when the broadband drops, and because nothing lives on one computer, a dead machine loses nothing.

Can my staff use Jwero in their own language?

The staff app for attendance, leave and payslips works in multiple languages, and WhatsApp replies go out in the customer’s language. Onboarding and support are in your language.

Will my shop stop billing while we switch?

No. Your current billing software keeps running until you choose to move. We import your customers, catalogue and stock, usually in a day, and you can bill in Jwero alongside the old system while your team settles in. A written change-freeze keeps your season untouched, and your data exports any time if you decide to stop.

Where is Jwero, and who do I talk to?

Jwero is made by Tech Jewels Private Limited, a registered Indian company with its office in Thane, next to Mumbai; the registration number is on the company page. You talk to a Jwero specialist on WhatsApp, by phone on +91 91699 59959 or by email at care@jwero.ai, 10am to 8pm India time. Outside those hours a chat still reaches us and a call becomes a callback.

Who owns my data?

You do. Every business runs in its own isolated database, and you can export everything, any time. Read about security.
